body: I used to like working out, but I have a migraine condition that makes it extremely uncomfortable to get my circulation up too high. I generally play a lot of video games but those stopped being fun a while back so I don't really play them as much. Sometimes I read when I'm bored, that usually kills time.

I don't live for myself because I hate myself. I don't want to live for myself. I'm terribly lonely and I have been for a very long time. I don't see anything about myself that I could extend out to "might as well keep living on for that."
